contentText: Thousands of Cubans gathered on Friday morning before the US embassy in Havana to protest a US decision to indict former president ​Raul ‌Castro in the downing of two civilian airplanes ⁠30 years ago. The pro-government demonstration, which began shortly after sunrise on Havana's waterfront, comes as ‌Cuban officials rallied this week around the island's revolutionary hero ⁠amid spiraling tensions with the United States. FRANCE 24's Ed Augustin reports from Havana, Cuba.
